provider: Old Republic Title (ortratecalculator.oldrepublictitle.com premium calculator -- a distinct, previously-uncatalogued Old Republic system, different from the ortconline.com/Web2 tool already on file for other states, which does NOT serve CT)
endpoint: GET/POST ortratecalculator.oldrepublictitle.com/RateCalc.aspx (classic ASP.NET WebForms __doPostBack/__VIEWSTATE/__EVENTVALIDATION app, driven with a plain requests.Session(); CallingApp=PUBLIC&Location=06 auto-establishes a temporary session via a redirect chain through /Login.aspx to a session-scoped URL -- no credentials, account, or personal data required at any point)
scenario: $500,000 purchase price, $400,000 loan, statewide Connecticut (this tool has no county/town dropdown for CT -- CT premiums are not county-tiered in this system, consistent with WFG/Stewart's statewide liability-tiered manuals already on file; Fairfield County substitution not applicable since the tool is statewide), residential purchase, Policy Category = SIMULTANEOUS LOAN & OWNERS, Owner's Type = OWNERS-BASIC, Lender's Type = SIMUL-LOAN RESIDENTIAL BASIC, Closing Protection Letter checkbox checked (tool's own editable default fee amount of $50.00, not verified against CT's statutory C.G.S.A. Sec. 38a-404 CPL amount -- see bundlingNotes)
methodology: Found via Quiet Title LLC's (a CT/MD/DC/VA title company) own 'Title Insurance Calculators' resource page, which links directly to Old Republic's per-state RateCalc.aspx tool with Location=06 confirmed as Connecticut. Driven end-to-end with a plain Python requests.Session(): (1) GET the Location=06 URL, which redirects through /Login.aspx and back to a session-scoped RateCalc.aspx URL returning HTTP 200 with no login required; (2) POST with __EVENTTARGET set to the Policy Category dropdown (value=5, SIMULTANEOUS LOAN & OWNERS) to reveal the Owner's Type/Purchase Price/Lender's Type/Loan Amount/CPL-checkbox fields; (3) POST with ddlPolicyType1=6699 (OWNERS-BASIC), txtLiabilityAmt=500000, ddlPolicyType2=6702 (SIMUL-LOAN RESIDENTIAL BASIC), txtCrLiabilityAmt=400000, chkFee=on, txtFeeAmount=50.00, and btnCalculate clicked -- returns the itemized results grid inline in the same page's UpdatePanelResults.
